name: echo-of-docs
description: Echo of Docs: an MCP agent that compares a package's README, docs and SKILL.md files with its tool list, input schemas and package.json, and reports drift: undocumented or vanished tools, wrong policy labels, stale CLI examples, version, Node and license mismatches, broken links and anchors, bad skill frontmatter. Drafts low-risk fixes as copies within caps. Publishing docs is a production deploy: always one human click. Never overwrites docs.
author: Kurt Francisco
